column1: # Game profile of DAVE THE DIVER (Switch, update 1.0.6.1267 = v3080192). Plays on the Mac
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file

# Unity 6000.0.52f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 20.5.29, NVN; subsdk0 is the movie module. The shaders are Unity's Shader and ComputeShader objects in the player's serialized files and the StreamingAssets bundles, read by unityfs.py, and the player's 11 GLSLC outputs in main.
# The game asks for present interval 2 and runs at 30 fps. Docked (1920x1080) with the 2D pad layout

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true and main never sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself.
# The hardware pool leaves Unity room here (README.md, Memory)
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near = 0) (log: "depth mode near=0"), so its vertex shaders use the main0_z entries; the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader and ComputeShader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
# everything is under Data/: the player's serialized files and the StreamingAssets bundles
